about.title: About
about.intro: I'm a senior backend developer and technical lead, working mostly with C# and .NET. I design and modernize enterprise systems, and I lead a team of five developers while staying hands-on in architecture and code.

journey.title: How I got here
journey.text: I started as a full-stack developer maintaining legacy enterprise applications. Over the years I moved into backend architecture for a new platform and, later, into technical leadership. Working with both legacy and modern code shaped how I decide: I weigh business continuity, scalability and maintainability together.

craft.title: Development and leadership
craft.text: I favor Clean Architecture and SOLID because they keep systems easy to change, and I pick tools for the problem at hand. As a technical lead, I review code, mentor developers and help define the engineering standards the team works by.

ai.title: Exploring AI
ai.text: I'm studying AI systems development and management, and I use study projects to explore LLMs, AI agents, RAG and prompt engineering, with a focus on validating what the models produce. They are learning projects, and I present them that way in the AI Lab.

metadata.title: Experience | Bruno Lucildo
metadata.description: Bruno Lucildo's career path from full-stack developer to backend technical lead: roles, responsibilities and results across more than ten years of enterprise software.

experience.title: Experience
experience.intro: Ten-plus years at a steel distribution and industrial solutions company, from full-stack developer to technical lead of the team building its new ERP platform.

techLead.title: Technical Lead
techLead.context: I lead the team of five software engineers who develop and modernize the company's new ERP platform, while staying hands-on in architecture and development.
responsibilities: Provide technical direction, mentoring and architectural guidance to a team of five software engineers.
Define the software architecture and engineering standards for the new ERP platform; the standards have been adopted across multiple teams.
Review code and coach developers, with more than 200 pull requests reviewed.
Drive technical decisions across modern and legacy components, balancing business continuity, scalability and maintainability.
achievements: Led the modernization of more than five business-critical services, including user registration and access and sales operations, migrating legacy modules to .NET services.

Under my technical leadership, my team designed and implemented distributed solutions with RabbitMQ that cut the time to add items to sales orders by 80%, measured before and after the change in production.
Improved backend performance through PostgreSQL query optimization and service-level improvements.

seniorBackend.title: Senior Backend Engineer
seniorBackend.context: I was responsible for the backend architecture and implementation of the company's next-generation ERP.
responsibilities: Designed and developed scalable REST APIs with ASP.NET Core.
Designed relational data models and optimized queries across SQL Server and PostgreSQL to improve API performance.
Implemented search with MongoDB Atlas Search and introduced Redis for distributed caching and session management.
Developed asynchronous integrations with RabbitMQ and JWT-based authentication and authorization.
Built data access layers with Entity Framework and Dapper.

fullStack2020.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
fullStack2020.context: I built and maintained enterprise applications, business intelligence and data integrations for the company.
responsibilities: Developed enterprise web applications supporting core business processes.
Designed and implemented the company's Balanced Scorecard platform.
Built Business Intelligence dashboards for operational and management reporting.
Developed ETL processes with Azure Data Factory.
Developed applications and integrations with Node.js and JavaScript, and maintained legacy applications built on InterSystems Caché.

fullStack2018.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
fullStack2018.context: I developed and maintained internal enterprise web applications.
responsibilities: Implemented new features and enhancements for business-critical systems.
Maintained and evolved legacy applications as part of the company's software development initiatives.

fullStack2016.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
fullStack2016.context: I started my career supporting the development and maintenance of internal enterprise applications.
responsibilities: Implemented new features and enhancements for business systems.
Built my software engineering foundations working with enterprise applications and legacy technologies.
